name: box-data-extract
description: Reads Box folder files and per-file detail metadata, and writes file rename/description updates, through the Box REST API using the OAuth2 client-credentials grant.

risk.read: external Box API read of folder files and per-file detail metadata
risk.write: external mutation renaming or updating the description of a Box file
risk.approval: required for the update_file write action; read remains unapproved
